PAIRING requested\n-> Perform pairing steps. Connect again

To calibrate the sensor, place your forearm on a table with a rolled-up towel for padding. Your hand should hang off the edge of the table with your palm facing down. With the opposite hand, press the "START" button. Then, slowly move your hand upward until you feel a gentle stretch. After that, return your hand to the starting position. Repeat this movement three times. Once completed, press the "FINISH" button with the opposite hand.

1. Wear the wristband.
2. Support the forearm on flat surface with the wrist over the edge.
3. Use your opposite hand to gently move the injured wrist through flexion and extension within a pain-free range.
4. Slowly bend the wrist upward and downward.
